title: Hubspot email animated gif clickthrough loss

change.control: Near-plain-text marketing email with minimal HTML for tracking and links.
change.variant: Add an animated GIF image to the marketing email.

significance.reported: Publisher says the plainer variation won with statistical significance.

quote: For the plain-text vs. .GIF image test, the .GIF version had a 2.3% lower clickthrough rate.
notes: Lower opens plus lower clickthrough rate meant the plain-text version got 42% more total clicks. No reversed-baseline total-click lift is calculated. Source original exact publication date unknown; displayed date is an update.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
